events.title: Demuth on King Guided Tours
events.description: Visit the Demuth Museum of Art on King second and fourth Saturdays at 1 pm for a guided tour! Our Demuth docents will guide you through the home and studio of Charles Demuth and talk about his life and work as they relate to each room of the house. Tours are by donation - recommended donation is $10. Summer/Fall 2026 Tour Dates: June 13 July 11 & 25 August 8 & 22 September 12 & 26 October 10 & 24 November 14 & 28

events.title: Lancaster Art History Panel
events.description: Lancaster has a rich and dynamic visual arts community. For centuries, artists have found inspiration and community here. Join us for a panel discussion that explores the artists, patrons, and businesses that have helped shape today's arts scene. This event is free and open to all through generous support from Art Bridges. RSVPs appreciated - please fill out your information through the form below. Thank you! events.title: Two Dudes Color Mix
events.description: Two Dudes and Sherwin-Williams present Color Mix, an immersive color experience at the Demuth Museum of Art on Lime. For one night only, join local and regional interior designers, architects, contractors, and painters for an interactive exploration of Sherwin-Williams' 2027 colors of the year. What To Expect: Immersive Color Experience, courtesy of Lancaster-based interior design firms Cash Bar Cotton Candy by Little Cotton Candy Cart Live Music Networking with local home renovation experts Featured Designers: Henrietta Heisler Interiors Beers + Hoffman Architecture AK Interiors Ville & Rue TONO Group David Lyall This event is organized by Two Dudes and Sherwin-Williams. Learn more and reserve your spot on Eventbrite.

events.description: Join us for a day of modern art in Philadelphia! Very limited seating available - email skeim@demuth.org or call (717) 299-9940 to check availability. Image: Calder Gardens. Photo by Iwan Baan

events.title: Deem Day + ExtraGive Celebration
events.description: Join us in commemoration of Charles Demuth’s Birthday during the ExtraGive! “Deem” was an affectionate nickname of Demuth’s and we’re marking this day with fun, food, & art for all. We are also partnering with Lancaster County Chooses Love at our Program Center (116 East King Street) to present screenings of Amish Country Queer and a presentation of Brady Pappas’ Tulle Queer series. Space may be limited - register online for a spot!
